sentences.text:
the compromise reads as under:
" 3.

The Cross-Objector and respondent have mutually agreed for compromise on the following terms and conditions:
i.

The respondent has unequivocally and unconditionally agreed that all the averments she had made claiming herself as legally married wife of the cross-objector is incorrect and that the respondent shall henceforth not make any claims to be the wife of the cross- objector before any authority/forum/ court.
ii. That the respondent has agreed to unconditionally withdraw or co-operate in quashing Criminal Misc. 506/2011 pending on the file of Addl.
Civil Judge and JMFC, Ranebennur filed by her U/s 12(1) of Domestic Violence Act against the Cross-Objector and all the averments made therein.

iii. The respondent has further agreed to withdraw or co- operate in quashing of proceedings initiated by her in NC: 2023:KHC-D:10878 C.C.
No. 563/2013 pending on the file of Addl.

Civil Judge and JMFC, Ranebennur filed against the Cross- Objector and his father and mother namely K.P. Malleshwarachar and V. Manjula Mallesh for offences punishable U/S 498A, 307, 504, 323, 342 of IPC and all the averments and allegations made therein.

iv. The respondent has also consented to withdrawal of Criminal Misc. 19/2015 on the file of Addl. Civil Judge and JMFC, Ranebennur against the Cross-Objector filed U/S 125 of Cr.P.C. praying for maintenance and all the averments made therein.

v. The respondent has unconditionally and in unequivocal terms agreed that she will withdraw the O.S. No. 219/2020 instituted by her on the file of Principal Civil Judge,
Ranebennur against the Cross-Objector praying for permanent injunction restraining the Cross-Objector who was arrayed as a defendant therein from performing the second marriage and all the averments/allegations made by her therein.

vi. The Cross- objector has unconditionally agreed to withdraw O.S. No. 81/2021 instituted by him against the Respondent on the file of Principal Civil Judge,
Ranebennur praying for permanent injunction against the Respondent/ defendant therein from using the name of the cross- objector/ plaintiff therein as the respondent's husband in future.
vii.

The cross-objector has agreed to withdraw O.S. No. 100/2023 instituted by him against Nagaraj NC: 2023:KHC-D:10878 Arkachari on the file of Principal Civil Judge, Ranebennur for defaming the Cross- Objector and praying to direct the said Nagaraj Arkachari who was arrayed as defendant therein to pay damages of Rs.
5,00,000/- with interest at 9% from the date of filing of the suit.

sentences.text: 5. Both the cross-objector and the respondent admit before the Court of having entered into compromise which is lawful.
The terms of the compromise would indicate that both the cross-objector and the respondent have agreed to withdraw the pending litigations between them.
The respondent has also agreed that she shall, henceforth, not make any claim to be the wife of the cross-objector before any authority/forum/Court.
4. The condition Nos.iii, iv and v are relating to withdrawal of all the cases between the parties, one of which is the subject proceedings.
In the light of settlement arrived at between the parties, I deem it appropriate to close these proceedings, obliterating the crime against the petitioners.

6. For the aforesaid reasons, the following:
ORDER i) Criminal Petition is disposed of.
ii) The proceedings in CC.No.563/2013 pending on the file of the II Addl. JMFC,
Ranebennur stands quashed.
